summary: Frontend E2E for Logistics install customer sign-off & warranty activation flow. All acceptance criteria pass: login → /logistics portal → ALL-LOGQA2 pending install visible → Install pack modal opens with Start install + Complete & sign-off buttons (relink hidden) → Start install shows 'Install marked in progress' toast → Complete modal opens with all fields (checks, installer name, condition, customer name, signature pad canvas, H&S ack, acceptance) → validation blocks submit with distinct error toasts for missing customer name, signature, H&S ack, and acceptance → happy path (name + drawn signature + H&S + acceptance + checks) triggers success toast 'Signed off — asset active, warranty to 12 Jul 2028' → completion modal closes → install drops off the upcoming list. Signature canvas captured via mouse drag successfully.

issues: Sonner error toasts stack vertically at top and partially overlay the modal header ('Complete & customer sign-off' title obscured). Consider bottom-right placement or de-dup toast when multiple validation errors fire simultaneously.

critical_code_review_comments: Validation errors are emitted as separate toasts per missing field; UX would be cleaner with a single consolidated error toast or inline field errors.

Completed banner (inv-install-pack-completed) could not be visually verified inline because the install disappears from the upcoming list after commissioning (no reopen path in the logistics portal); backend already curl-verified. If desired, keep completed installs in the list for a short window so installer can review the banner immediately.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded ALL-LOGQA2. NOTE: install was consumed by happy-path (now active). Main agent must reseed a fresh pending install for any re-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow is verified end-to-end. Reseed ALL-LOGQA2 (or equivalent) before re-testing. Signature pad drawing works with playwright mouse.move+down/up sequences on the canvas inside [data-testid=logistics-signature-pad]. Rate limit ~4 rapid logins — reuse session.
